book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
stem_md: 设 $a_1, a_2, \cdots, a_n > 0$ 且 $a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n = 1$. 求证: $$\left(\frac{1}{a_1^2} - 1\right)\left(\frac{1}{a_2^2} - 1\right) \cdots \left(\frac{1}{a_n^2} - 1\right) \geqslant (n^2 - 1)^n.$$
original_text_md: 设 $a_1, a_2, \cdots, a_n > 0$ 且 $a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n = 1$. 求证: $$\left(\frac{1}{a_1^2} - 1\right)\left(\frac{1}{a_2^2} - 1\right) \cdots \left(\frac{1}{a_n^2} - 1\right) \geqslant (n^2 - 1)^n.$$
